review.observedFace: Own-SKU photo-extra-9 documents a closed opaque exterior rear. Photo-extra-5 is an oblique opened assembly, not a calibrated orthographic PCB image. Native STL rear component2 has a central through-opening.
review.decision: Add a separately classified photo-estimated rear closure; never project the opened-assembly photograph onto a flat PCB. Preserve every original STL triangle, scale and rigid transform.
review.unknownPolicy: Both original internal UNKNOWN PCB labels remain at their existing positions. The closure follows the rear inspection group, so removing the rear exposes the unknown internals.
review.limits: Exact rear face thickness, embossed M5/TOUGH relief, installed screw hardware, adhesive pads, board component geometry and closure assembly remain unknown/approximate.

measurementScope: Production loader meshes, excluding UNKNOWN annotation planes and photo/print planes. Approximate connectors/components retained; this is not a manufacturing pass.
